costs.accounting_scope: Each actual candidate fit and extra control fit is counted once; reused per-model search receipts are not summed again across budgets. Work proxies are not hardware FLOPs or currency. Research retention includes alternatives/receipts/trace output and is distinct from one deployed instance. External shared MiniLM base is charged by the routing owner, not factor-only capacity reads.

exact_complete_storage.interpretation: CO2 has a small 65-byte exact-state saving. Temperature, sunspots and Digits fail the stronger exact-storage comparison. Declared local structure permits much larger savings; pure random sources do not.

synthetic_rate_distortion_boundary.note: Declared local-subspace source; all candidates and shared metadata are charged.
Rank-zero archival savings are center-plus-residual coding, not rich information stored in model weights.

measurement_contract.budget: The same model-artifact byte ceiling applies to every family. It includes factors, decoder, centers, routes, masks and headers. Shared address/provenance metadata is additionally charged and reported, and actual occupied bytes need not be equal.
measurement_contract.digits: Digits pixel recall is a new memory task on an already used dataset, not an independent new domain.
measurement_contract.exact_codec: Parameter-only read and model-plus-explicit-residual reconstruction are distinct arms. All exact byte comparisons include the shared address/provenance state.
measurement_contract.facts: All facts are supplied at write time. Hidden coordinates test retrieval of written facts, not unseen-fact prediction or forecasting.
measurement_contract.gain: (stronger_control_MSE - candidate_MSE) / stronger_control_MSE. Gain and CI are null when the control MSE is zero; absolute errors and win/loss/tie counts remain mandatory.
measurement_contract.mse_units: MSE uses source-scaled integers; physical-unit MAE is reported separately. Cross-domain raw MSE values are not pooled.
measurement_contract.predeclared: Numeric predeclared cells use temporal partitions. Digits predeclared cells use writer-visible original digit labels, whose deployed row routes are serialized and charged.
measurement_contract.selection: Architecture/rank selection uses only the declared 20% selection coordinates; model fitting legitimately sees every written fact. All five selected-rank lists and selection losses are retained in the full real-domain table.

statistics.inference_unit: Seed conditional on each fixed workload; SVD itself is deterministic. Domain counts are not seed counts.
statistics.limited_trials: Five trials do not establish population safety, universal transfer, or distribution-free superiority.

measurement_contract.stronger_control: For reporting, take the lower hidden MSE of independently trained global SVD and VQ in each seed. This is a conservative evaluation comparator, not a deployed oracle router or a hidden-result training policy.

stage_1.decision: PASS for the tested integer and coordinate-numeric parameter-memory mechanisms; no general language-memory claim
limitations: Zero hidden error on a finite query set is not a proof of full-source exactness at every coordinate.
IntegerBitCell is an actually trained small neural model; FactorBank is fitted matrix factorization rather than language-model fine-tuning.
Native inference/owner recovery passes while production signals remain abstaining and calibration is not admitted.
No claim that the native small model compresses arbitrary random facts more efficiently than a strong exact codec.

stage_2.decision: CONDITIONAL PASS for declared local-memory workloads; uniform superiority is false and historical v2 gates remain unchanged

negative_findings: CO2 and temperature learned cells lose to the stronger control at all three smaller budgets.
At the highest budget CO2 and temperature learned cells each lose in one seed and tie in four; neither is an all-seed tie.
Sunspots at 6648 bytes has mixed seed outcomes and a negative mean relative gain, while its highest budget is a five-seed exact tie.
Digits higher budgets are exact ties, and its lower-budget gains do not count as a new independent source.
Bounded random data can show a lossy nonlinear-codebook advantage at some budgets; that does not imply lossless compression of its independent information.
stage_2.route_gap_scope: Capacity reads use the exact serialized row-address route, so actual equals declared oracle by construction. This does not establish semantic routing; its failures remain in routing-findings.json.

stage_6.capacity_generality_limit: The three science sources were used in development; Digits pixels reuse an existing source. Factor memory is numeric and does not establish a new semantic, episodic or procedural primitive type. Held-domain mechanics and semantic quality are therefore reported separately.
stage_6.decision: FAIL reliable semantic transfer and broader general-memory qualification; the declared no-policy-update transfer mechanics pass
stage_6.interpretation: Frozen write/address/compose mechanics transfer with zero policy updates. Reliable semantic transfer is not established because the same per-domain semantic gate fails on the held economic domain. The protocol transfer clause adds no separate accuracy threshold; the existing semantic gate applies to every formal domain.

protocol_clause.scope: Transfer of fixed English intent/layout policy to newly written numeric records; not open-ended universal memory.
